title: asperula glomerata subsp. filiformis
intro: Asperula glomerata subsp. filiformis, commonly known as Woodruff, is a perennial herb belonging to the Rubiaceae family. It is traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, including reducing inflammation and alleviating digestive issues, as well as exhibiting antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Woodruff include acting as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic agent, which may help in soothing wounds and relieving respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Woodruff include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
